name: AUTH_REQUEST_HX_2
description: This table contains a snapshot of information about an individual authorization request as of a point in time.

columns.name: AUTH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the authorization request record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date from which this authorization request is effective.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: The date after which the authorization request is no longer valid. The system will re-calculate this date as changes are made to the authorization unless it was entered by the user.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_USER_SET_DATE
columns.description: The user-entered date after which the authorization request is no longer valid.

columns.name: SUBMIT_CLM_BY_DATE
columns.description: The date by which claims must be submitted to be paid. The system will re-calculate this date as changes are made to the authorization unless it was entered by the user.

columns.name: SUBMIT_CLM_BY_USER_SET_DATE
columns.description: The user-entered date by which claims must be submitted to be paid.
